title: WordPress page.create opens a plain-blocks page with its h1 when the page template prints no title, and only then
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/page-create.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# pass', '# fail', '# skipped' lines and the result of the WordPress tests named below.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# skipped 0'.

'WordPress: plain blocks open with the page’s h1 when its template prints no title, and only then' is ok: with tracy-base's page.html (no core/post-title), or only an index template like it, the written post_content starts with '\n

Common questions

' and holds one h1; with a page template that prints core/post-title, or one that hands its body to a pattern, the body holds no h1.

'WordPress: no map pins page markup → plain blocks, and the answer says so' and 'WordPress: the FAQ page in the theme's own section markup …' stay ok (a component without the template kind, and a pinned recipe, are left as they were).
evidence: dskeepwp (tracy-base wp7), 10/10/2026: the page 'Dịch vụ' (post 264) made by page.create in plain blocks had no h1: its first heading is an h3, and tracy-base's templates/page.html is header + post-content + footer with no core/post-title.
fence: Mechanism only, over the WordPress component fake with theme template files: whether the plain body opens with an h1. The theme is not changed.
